gaps.what: Per-ministry Organisatiebesluit for ambtelijke dienstonderdelen of B (agentschap, inspectie, uitvoeringsorganisatie) without a specific statutory basis
gaps.why: these units are established by a ministerial organisatiebesluit, not by a wet; the specific besluit per ministerie was not fetched in this pass
gaps.resume: Search the Wettenbank per ministerie for 'Organisatiebesluit Ministerie van ...' and add explicit id mappings for the affected dienstonderdelen.

gaps.what: Sectorale instellingswet per RWT that received only the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 class ground
gaps.why: the RWT-status is defined in the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 art. 1.1, but the substantive instellingswet or sectorwet per body was not confirmed for every register entry
gaps.resume: Walk the ROO RWT register, read each entry's wettelijke taak link, and add an explicit id mapping with the first specific wet.

gaps.what: Instellingswet per ZBO that received only the Kaderwet ZBO's class ground
gaps.why: the Kaderwet ZBO's art. 1 defines zbo status; the specific instellingswet per body could not be confirmed for every register entry
gaps.resume: Read each ZBO register entry's wettelijke grondslag and add an explicit id mapping with the instellingswet.

gaps.what: Veiligheidsregio's als klasse zijn niet gemapt; workstream G heeft geen veiligheidsregio-organisaties opgeleverd
gaps.why: G named the veiligheidsregio's and their relations as a gap, so a subtype:veiligheidsregio selector would match zero records and register as an unmatched mapping at merge
gaps.resume: When G adds the 25 veiligheidsregio's, add the selector subtype:veiligheidsregio to Wet veiligheidsregio's art. 8.

gaps.what: Grondwet afdeling over de Nationale ombudsman is art. 78a only; arts. 78b-78f do not exist in the current consolidated text
gaps.why: the task reference listed 78a-78f; the fetched 2023-02-22 consolidation contains Artikel 78 and Artikel 78a and no 78b-78f
gaps.resume: Confirm the article list at each refresh; keep art. 78a as the ombudsman basis and drop the 78b-78f reference.
